mapper.select: /* CastDepMapper.retrieveChknList */ SELECT SUBSTR(CKNCT_ID, 0, 1) as ISLAND, PMOWN.FN_PM_SAFE_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 2, 2)) as COUNTER_NUM, A.ALN_CD, PMOWN.FN_PM_SAFE_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.EST_BGNG_HM, 0, 2)) as "START", CEIL((A.EST_END_HM) / 100) as "END" FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CKNCT_DALY_ALOT A WHERE OPER_YMD = #{ymd} AND TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ISLAND, COUNTER_NUM, ALN_CD
